mapper.select: select dept_id idNumber, count(*) count from bus_cadre_archive where deleted = 0 group by dept_id

select distinct a.* from bus_cadre_archive a left join bus_cadre_archive_dept d on a.dept_id = d.id where a.deleted = 0
and (a.cadre_name like concat('%', #{req.cadreName}, '%') or a.cadre_name_py like concat(#{req.cadreName}, '%'))
and (a.dept_id = #{req.deptId} or concat(',', d.ancestors, ',') like concat('%,', #{req.deptId}, ',%'))
and d.dept_name like concat('%', #{req.archiveDeptName}, '%')
and a.archive_stock_status = #{req.archiveStockStatus}
